description: This Java class demonstrates how to implement HTML content printing from a WebView in an Android application. It loads HTML content from a local resource and enables printing via the Android PrintManager, triggered through an options menu.

classes.name: PrintHtmlFromScreen
classes.description: An Android Activity that loads HTML content into a WebView and provides a menu option to print the content.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures the WebView, and loads the HTML page. Sets a WebViewClient to detect when the page has finished loading.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu and inflates the print menu item only after the web page has loaded.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items, triggering the print function when the print menu item is chosen.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Uses Android's PrintManager to initiate printing of the WebView content.
